title: CHAPTER TEN. The resurrection of the flesh is demonstrated certainly future from the Old Testament
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): So far we have seen such that ye resurrection belonging toward ye flesh stands as possible: now we shall demonstrate out from ye Scriptures plus out from orthodox antiquity such that it stands as certainly future. || The resurrection belonging toward ye flesh stands as demonstrated to be certainly future out from ye Old Testament. Caput ye tenth.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER TEN. The resurrection of the flesh is demonstrated to be certainly future from the Old Testament.
So far we have seen that the resurrection of the flesh is possible: now we shall demonstrate from the Scriptures and from orthodox antiquity that it is certainly future.
source_text: CAPUT DECIMUM. Resurrectionem carnis certo futuram demonstratur e Veteri Testamento. Hactenus vidimus resurrectionem carnis esse possibilem: nunc demonstrabimus e scripturis & orthodoxa antiquitate, eam certo futuram.
